name: 420Analytics
purpose: Rebuildable analytics, metrics, trends, cohorts and dashboards derived from canonical public 420 Integrated chain and protocol state.
invariants: ANL-INV-001: 420Analytics owns no canonical protocol state and requires no Analytics-specific Genesis contract.
ANL-INV-002: Every metric is derived from identified canonical or explicitly authorized public sources and preserves provenance sufficient for independent recomputation.
ANL-INV-003: Metrics, KPIs, charts, cohorts, labels, rankings, anomaly scores and forecasts are non-canonical derived data and cannot override source protocol state.
ANL-INV-004: On-chain analytics remain bound to chain ID and indexed/finalized heights; finalized history is not silently rewritten.
ANL-INV-005: The complete Analytics index can be rebuilt from supported canonical sources without trusting a hosted Analytics database.
ANL-INV-006: Window definitions, aggregation methodology and relevant version identifiers are exposed so a published metric can be independently reproduced.

ANL-INV-007: Private Messenger/Commons content, encrypted Resource payloads, private Identity fields and raw Attention telemetry are excluded from Analytics unless the owning protocol publishes an authorized public aggregate.
ANL-INV-008: Analytics operators gain no custody, smart-account execution, governance, bridge, validator, arbitration, rights, payment or token-transfer authority.
ANL-INV-009: Analytics failure, staleness or disagreement cannot prevent direct protocol use or alter canonical accounting or settlement.
ANL-INV-010: Alternative analytics providers and methodologies are permitted; no hosted Analytics API or dashboard is a consensus dependency.
